NumericalGlobalEnsemble.description: Physics-based numerical global ensemble forecast model.

NumericalGlobalDeterministic.description: Physics-based numerical global deterministic forecast model.

Reanalysis.description: Retrospective analysis produced by assimilating observations.

Analysis.description: Objective analysis at the initialisation time (lead 0).

Other.description: A class not covered above; MODEL_ID identifies the producer's model.

Member.description: One perturbed ensemble member; MEMBER_INDEX selects it.

Percentile.description: Ensemble percentile; PERCENTILE holds the rank in [0, 100].

ProbabilityAboveThreshold.description: Probability that the variable exceeds THRESHOLD_VALUE, in [0, 1].

ProbabilityBelowThreshold.description: Probability that the variable falls below THRESHOLD_VALUE, in [0, 1].

Unspecified.description: The source does not identify a member or ensemble statistic. A blended point-forecast product must not be labelled as one deterministic run.
VARIABLE_NAME carries the producer's own variable name.

Temperature2m.description: Air temperature at 2 m above ground, kelvin.

DewpointTemperature2m.description: Dew-point temperature at 2 m above ground, kelvin.

WindU10m.description: Eastward wind component at 10 m above ground, m/s.

WindV10m.description: Northward wind component at 10 m above ground, m/s.

WindSpeed10m.description: Wind speed at 10 m above ground, m/s.

WindU100m.description: Eastward wind component at 100 m above ground, m/s.

WindV100m.description: Northward wind component at 100 m above ground, m/s.

WindSpeed100m.description: Wind speed at 100 m above ground, m/s.

SurfaceSolarRadiationDownwards.description: Surface downward shortwave radiation accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, J/m^2.

TotalSkyDirectSolarRadiationAtSurface.description: Total-sky direct shortwave radiation at the surface accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, J/m^2.

TotalPrecipitation.description: Total precipitation accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, metres of water equivalent.

TotalPrecipitationSatelliteBlended.description: Total precipitation trained against a satellite-blended precipitation analysis, accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, metres of water equivalent.

TotalPrecipitationExperimental.description: Experimental total precipitation product, accumulated over ACCUMULATION_HOURS, metres of water equivalent.

Geopotential.description: Geopotential on a pressure level, m^2/s^2.

Temperature.description: Air temperature on a pressure level, kelvin.

SpecificHumidity.description: Specific humidity on a pressure level, kg/kg.

WindU.description: Eastward wind component on a pressure level, m/s.

WindV.description: Northward wind component on a pressure level, m/s.

VerticalVelocity.description: Vertical velocity on a pressure level, Pa/s.

GeopotentialHeight.description: Geopotential height, geopotential metres (gpm): the height a producer such as GFS publishes on pressure levels and at the tropopause. Distinct from Geopotential (m^2/s^2); a consumer never relabels one as the other.

HeightAboveGround.description: Fixed height above ground; LEVEL_VALUE in metres.

MeanSeaLevel.description: Mean sea level; LEVEL_VALUE is unused.

EntireAtmosphere.description: Whole atmospheric column; LEVEL_VALUE is unused.

TopOfAtmosphere.description: Top of atmosphere; LEVEL_VALUE is unused.

Tropopause.description: The producer's diagnosed tropopause; LEVEL_VALUE is unused. Its height is a GeopotentialHeight field at this level, never implied by a pressure.

Accumulated.description: Sum over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

Averaged.description: Mean over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

Maximum.description: Maximum over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

Minimum.description: Minimum over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

RegularLatLon.description: Regular latitude-longitude grid with constant DLAT / DLON.

InlineFloat32.description: Samples are inline in VALUES (NLAT * NLON <= 1,048,576 cells).

ContentAddressedChunk.description: Samples are a content-addressed chunk named by CHUNK_CID; CHUNK_DTYPE / CHUNK_CODECS describe its layout. Used above 1,048,576 cells.

RealTimeExperimental.description: Real-time or future-valid data offered under an experimental real-time terms-of-use; not an official warning; redistribution limited per LICENSE_URL.

Historical.description: Data older than the producer's real-time window, offered under an open attribution licence named by LICENSE_URL.

OpenAttribution.description: Data of any valid time offered under an open attribution licence named by LICENSE_URL. Unlike Historical, this makes no claim about age or a producer's real-time window. API access terms can be more restrictive than the licence on the resulting data and must be checked separately.

Initialization.description: INIT_TIME_MS names a run; VALID_TIME_MS = INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3,600,000. This is the existing WXF convention.

ValidTimeOnly.description: Only VALID_TIME_MS is known. The source may blend runs or omit their initialization times. INIT_TIME_MS, LEAD_HOURS and HORIZON_HOURS MUST be omitted; their zero defaults do not mean a run in 1970, zero lead, or zero horizon. RETRIEVED_AT is not a substitute for initialization.

GEOGRAPHIC_QUADTREE.description: Two root tiles, geographic (equirectangular) subdivision as described in the header. The scheme CesiumJS terrain and imagery use.

REPLACE.description: The children replace the parent: draw one or the other, never both. The only refinement a mass-conserving mixture needs.

ADD.description: The children add to the parent. Reserved; a producer MUST NOT publish it until a consumer contract for additive mixtures is defined.

UNSPECIFIED.description: Not stated. A consumer MUST refuse the tile.

CLOUD_EXTINCTION.description: Visible-light extinction coefficient of cloud condensate (liquid and ice), 1/m at the Gaussian's centre.

OTHER.description: A quantity this enum cannot express; FIELD_QUANTITY_NAME names it.

CUMULUS_HUMILIS.description: Cumulus humilis: fair-weather cumulus, wider than deep.

CUMULONIMBUS.description: Cumulonimbus, with or without an anvil.

TILE_MIXTURE.description: The merged mixture of a whole tile, not one cloud.

AUTHORED.description: Sampled directly from the source field or authored at this cell.

GRID_MERGE.description: Mass-conserving merge of the finer level on a regular grid of cell MERGE_CELL_M, silhouette preserved.

CLUSTER_MERGE.description: Mass-conserving k-means merge of the finer level into GAUSSIAN_COUNT clusters.

FITTED.description: Fitted to a voxel or observational field by optimisation.

INLINE_FLOAT32.description: Samples are inline in the level's vectors.

CONTENT_ADDRESSED_CHUNK.description: Samples are a content-addressed chunk named by the level's CHUNK_CID whose layout is the aligned-binary twin's section layout for the level; the level's vectors are absent.

INLINE.description: The variant's levels are carried in this tile.

SHARED_LIBRARY.description: The variant is a shared library entry named by VARIANT_CID; its levels are absent here and identical wherever the same CID appears, so a consumer keeps one copy however many tiles reference it.

WXFGrid.description:
Regular grid the samples are laid out on. Samples are row-major with
latitude as the outer index: cell (i, j) for 0 <= i < NLAT, 0 <= j < NLON
sits at VALUES[i * NLON + j] and is centred at
(LAT0 + i * DLAT, LON0 + j * DLON). DLAT is negative when rows run north
to south. Longitudes are in [-180, 180) or [0, 360) exactly as the
producer publishes them; a consumer normalises.

RegularLatLon.description: Regular latitude-longitude grid with constant DLAT / DLON.

LAT0.description: Latitude of the first row's cell centre, degrees north.

LON0.description: Longitude of the first column's cell centre, degrees east.

PERIODIC_LON.description: Whether the last column wraps to the first (global grid).

WXF.description:
Weather Forecast Field - One variable, level, member and valid time on a
regular grid.

FIELD_ID.description:
Stable identifier of the whole field this record belongs to; equal
across all tiles of one (producer, init, member, variable, level, lead).

Present only for TIME_BASIS Initialization.

LEAD_HOURS.description:

Initialization.

VALID_TIME_MS.description:
Time the field is valid at, Unix milliseconds UTC
(INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3.6e6 when TIME_BASIS is Initialization).

HORIZON_HOURS.description:
Maximum lead the run was integrated to, hours (e.g. 360 for a synoptic
cycle, 48 for an interim cycle). Omitted for ValidTimeOnly.

PERCENTILE.description: Percentile rank in [0, 100] when MEMBER_KIND is Percentile.

THRESHOLD_VALUE.description: Threshold in UNITS when MEMBER_KIND is a probability kind.

LEVEL_VALUE.description: Vertical coordinate value in the unit fixed by LEVEL_KIND.

TEMPORAL_KIND.description: Temporal character of each cell value.

Accumulated.description: Sum over the ACCUMULATION_HOURS ending at VALID_TIME_MS.

GRID.description: Grid geometry of this record's samples (of this tile when tiled).

TILE_INDEX.description: Zero-based tile index within FIELD_ID; 0 for an untiled field.

TILE_COUNT.description: Number of tiles FIELD_ID was split into; 1 for an untiled field.

InlineFloat32.description: Samples are inline in VALUES (NLAT * NLON <= 1,048,576 cells).

ContentAddressedChunk.description: Samples are a content-addressed chunk named by CHUNK_CID; CHUNK_DTYPE / CHUNK_CODECS describe its layout. Used above 1,048,576 cells.

CHUNK_CODECS.description:
Codec chain applied to the chunk, outermost last (e.g. "bytes",
"zstd").

VALUE_MIN.description:
Minimum sample over the field (after decoding); statistics for display
scaling without touching the chunk.

VALUE_MAX.description: Maximum sample over the field (after decoding).

MISSING_COUNT.description: Number of cells with a missing value.

Upstream publisher the field was retrieved from, as a host name or

Stable dataset identifier within the origin (e.g. a bucket, collection

SOURCE_URL.description: Upstream URL or object path the field was retrieved from.

RETRIEVED_AT.description: Unix milliseconds UTC when the field was retrieved from the origin.

API access terms can be more restrictive than the licence on the resulting data and must be checked separately.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms the field is offered under.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publisher asks for.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that ingested and published this record.

TIME_BASIS.description:
Times published by the source; governs whether initialization, lead
and horizon are meaningful. The default preserves existing records.

Initialization.description: INIT_TIME_MS names a run; VALID_TIME_MS = INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3,600,000. This is the existing WXF convention.

ValidTimeOnly.description: Only VALID_TIME_MS is known. The source may blend runs or omit their initialization times. INIT_TIME_MS, LEAD_HOURS and HORIZON_HOURS MUST be omitted; their zero defaults do not mean a run in 1970, zero lead, or zero horizon. RETRIEVED_AT is not a substitute for initialization.

GCTLevel.description:
One level of detail of one variant: a Gaussian mixture in the variant's
own frame (metres, origin at the variant's reference point, Z up, base of
the cloud near Z = 0). Levels are ordered finest first. Every per-Gaussian
vector holds exactly 4 * GAUSSIAN_COUNT float32 values — one RGBA texel
per Gaussian — in the same Gaussian order.

GAUSSIAN_COUNT.description: Number of Gaussians in this level.

MERGE_CELL_M.description:
The cell this level was merged on, metres: the level's geometric error
in the variant frame. Multiply by the instance scale in use.

AUTHORED.description: Sampled directly from the source field or authored at this cell.

GRID_MERGE.description: Mass-conserving merge of the finer level on a regular grid of cell MERGE_CELL_M, silhouette preserved.

CLUSTER_MERGE.description: Mass-conserving k-means merge of the finer level into GAUSSIAN_COUNT clusters.

FITTED.description: Fitted to a voxel or observational field by optimisation.

INLINE_FLOAT32.description: Samples are inline in the level's vectors.

CONTENT_ADDRESSED_CHUNK.description: Samples are a content-addressed chunk named by the level's CHUNK_CID whose layout is the aligned-binary twin's section layout for the level; the level's vectors are absent.

CHUNK_CID.description:
Content identifier of the chunk when ENCODING is
CONTENT_ADDRESSED_CHUNK.

CHUNK_BYTE_LENGTH.description: Encoded chunk length in bytes when ENCODING is CONTENT_ADDRESSED_CHUNK.

CENTERS.description:
Per Gaussian: x, y, z of the centre, metres in the variant frame; w =
amplitude in AMPLITUDE_UNITS at the centre.

SIGMAS.description:
Per Gaussian: standard deviation along the variant frame's x, y, z
axes, metres (axis-aligned; the instance yaw rotates the frame); w = a
per-Gaussian seed in [0, 1) for stochastic shading, 0 when unused.

BOUNDARY.description:
OPTIONAL. Per Gaussian: x, y, z of the field's boundary normal at the
centre (unit vector scaled by a boundary weight in [0, 1]: 0 deep
inside, 1 at a crisp condensation interface); w = the local coarse
density in [0, 1]. Absent when not computed.

FINE_NORMAL.description:
OPTIONAL. Per Gaussian: x, y, z of a finer-scale surface normal that
adds relief to BOUNDARY; w unused (0). Absent when not computed.

OPTICAL_DEPTH_POS.description:
OPTIONAL. Per Gaussian: optical depth of the field from the centre
outward along +x, +y, +z (dimensionless); w unused (0). Absent when
not computed.

OPTICAL_DEPTH_NEG.description:
OPTIONAL. Per Gaussian: optical depth along -x, -y, -z; w unused (0).
Absent when not computed.

GCTDistanceField.description:
A signed distance field of a variant's surface (the isosurface of the
mixture at DENSITY_THRESHOLD), on a cube of N^3 voxels over the variant's
bounds, stored as bytes: distance / DISTANCE_SCALE_M, negative inside,
clamped to [-128, 127]. Optional; a consumer without it sphere-traces
nothing and lights the variant from an atlas instead.

ORIGIN_M.description: Origin of voxel (0, 0, 0) in the variant frame, metres (3 values).

SPAN_M.description: Extent of the cube along each axis, metres (3 values).

DISTANCE_SCALE_M.description: Metres per byte step of DATA.

DENSITY_THRESHOLD.description: Density threshold, in AMPLITUDE_UNITS, that defines the surface.

MEAN_AMPLITUDE.description: Mean amplitude over the occupied volume, AMPLITUDE_UNITS.

DATA.description:
N^3 signed bytes, x fastest, then y, then z. Absent when the field
travels as the chunk named by CHUNK_CID.

CHUNK_CID.description: Content identifier of the field when DATA is absent.

GCTDensityVolume.description:
A baked density volume of a variant on the same cube as its distance
field, for ray marching: N^3 samples of amplitude in AMPLITUDE_UNITS,
float16, x fastest. Optional.

ORIGIN_M.description: Origin of voxel (0, 0, 0) in the variant frame, metres (3 values).

SPAN_M.description: Extent of the cube along each axis, metres (3 values).

DATA.description:
N^3 IEEE 754 half-precision samples as their 16-bit patterns, x
fastest, then y, then z. Absent when the volume travels as the chunk
named by CHUNK_CID.

CHUNK_CID.description: Content identifier of the volume when DATA is absent.

GCTVariant.description:
One variant: one cloud (or one tile's merged mixture) as a chain of
levels of detail in its own frame. Instances place variants in the tile.

VARIANT_ID.description: Producer-stable identifier of the variant within FIELD_ID.

INLINE.description: The variant's levels are carried in this tile.

SHARED_LIBRARY.description: The variant is a shared library entry named by VARIANT_CID; its levels are absent here and identical wherever the same CID appears, so a consumer keeps one copy however many tiles reference it.

VARIANT_CID.description:
Content identifier of the variant's levels when SCOPE is
SHARED_LIBRARY. Two references with equal VARIANT_CID are the same
bytes.

CUMULUS_HUMILIS.description: Cumulus humilis: fair-weather cumulus, wider than deep.

CUMULONIMBUS.description: Cumulonimbus, with or without an anvil.

TILE_MIXTURE.description: The merged mixture of a whole tile, not one cloud.

LEVELS.description:
Levels of detail, finest first, each conserving the mass of the one
before it. Absent when SCOPE is SHARED_LIBRARY.

BOUNDS_MIN_M.description:
Axis-aligned bounds of the finest level's support in the variant
frame, metres: min x, y, z (3 values).

BOUNDS_MAX_M.description: Axis-aligned bounds, max x, y, z (3 values).

MASS.description:
Total mass of the finest level: the integral of amplitude over space,
AMPLITUDE_UNITS times cubic metres. Every level MUST match it within
MASS_TOLERANCE.

DISTANCE_FIELD.description: Signed distance field of the surface. Optional.

DENSITY_VOLUME.description: Baked density volume for ray marching. Optional.

AUTHORING_SEED.description: Seed the producer authored the variant from, for reproducibility.

GCTInstance.description:
One placement of a variant in the tile frame. The transform applied to a
variant-frame point p is: scale by (SCALE_X, SCALE_Y, SCALE_Z), mirror per
SYMMETRY, rotate by YAW_RAD about +Z, translate by (X_M, Y_M, Z_M). The
aligned-binary INSTANCES section carries these fields in this order as
float32.

X_M.description: Position of the variant's origin in the tile frame, metres east.

Z_M.description: Metres up (above the tile's ENU origin).

SCALE_X.description: Scale along the variant frame's axes; 1 is the variant as authored.

YAW_RAD.description: Rotation about +Z, radians, counter-clockwise from east.

SYMMETRY.description:
One of eight axis mirror symmetries applied before the yaw: bit 0
mirrors x, bit 1 mirrors y, bit 2 swaps x and y.

EROSION.description:
Strength of the consumer's per-instance erosion and warp in [0, 1] (0:
the variant exactly as authored). Values above 2 select a shared deck
gap field with hole fraction VALUE - 2, per the producer's convention
stated in PRODUCER_NOTES.

CLOUD_ID.description:
Producer-stable identity of the cloud this instance belongs to, equal
across tiles, levels and valid times while the cloud persists — the
key a consumer fades and tracks by. 0 means unstated.

CLUSTER_ID.description:
Cluster the instance belongs to (a chain of cumulus, a tower), for
grouping; 0 means none.

SHAPE_ERROR_M.description:
Shape error, metres: the silhouette distance between this placement
and the cloud it stands in for. 0 means the instance IS the cloud (a
unique variant); a class stand-in placed for a chain of five cumulus
carries half the member spacing. A consumer that refines below the
shape error requests the unique variant.

WIDTH_M.description: Width of the cloud as placed, metres, for size-dependent decisions.

GCTCoverGrid.description:
The producer's reduction of the source fields to this tile's rectangle:
what a coarse tile draws as a continuous sheet before any Gaussian is
resolved. Samples are row-major with latitude as the outer index, cell
(i, j) centred at (LAT0_RAD + i * DLAT_RAD, LON0_RAD + j * DLON_RAD).

LAT0_RAD.description: Latitude of the first row's cell centre, radians.

LON0_RAD.description: Longitude of the first column's cell centre, radians.

LOW_COVER.description: Low-cloud cover fraction per cell, [0, 1]. NaN marks a missing cell.

MEDIUM_COVER.description: Medium-cloud cover fraction per cell, [0, 1]. Absent when unstated.

HIGH_COVER.description: High-cloud cover fraction per cell, [0, 1]. Absent when unstated.

BASE_HEIGHT_M.description:
Height of the low-cloud base per cell, metres above the ellipsoid
(the lifting condensation level over the ground height).

TOP_HEIGHT_M.description: Height of the low-cloud top per cell, metres above the ellipsoid.

COLUMN_OPTICAL_DEPTH.description:
Column optical depth per cell of the whole tile content along the
vertical, dimensionless. Absent when unstated.

GCT.description: Gaussian Cloud Tile: one quadtree tile of a volumetric field as a mass-conserving Gaussian mixture, rendering-ready, for one valid time.

FIELD_ID.description:
Stable identifier of the whole tiled field this tile belongs to; equal
across all tiles and levels of one (producer, source fields, valid
time, geometric-error ladder).

TILING.description: Quadtree the keys are stated in.

GEOGRAPHIC_QUADTREE.description: Two root tiles, geographic (equirectangular) subdivision as described in the header. The scheme CesiumJS terrain and imagery use.

CHILD_MASK.description:
Which of the four children exist (bits 0..3 as defined in the header).
0 on a leaf. A child that does not exist has no content anywhere
beneath it — clear sky is never traversed.

MAX_LEVEL.description:
Deepest level with content under this tile, when the producer knows
it; 255 when unstated.

REFINE.description: How the tile relates to its children.

REPLACE.description: The children replace the parent: draw one or the other, never both. The only refinement a mass-conserving mixture needs.

ADD.description: The children add to the parent. Reserved; a producer MUST NOT publish it until a consumer contract for additive mixtures is defined.

GEOMETRIC_ERROR_M.description:
The cell the tile's content was merged on, metres: its geometric
error. Children carry a smaller value than their parent.

WEST_RAD.description:
Bounding region of the content and every descendant's content, which
may exceed the nominal tile rectangle. Radians, WGS84.

MIN_HEIGHT_M.description: Lowest point of the region, metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid.

MAX_HEIGHT_M.description: Highest point of the region, metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid.

ORIGIN_LON_RAD.description:
The tile's east-north-up frame: geodetic origin, radians and metres
above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Instances and variants are stated in this
frame.

ENU_TO_ECEF.description:
Column-major 4x4 transform taking tile-frame points (metres) to WGS84
Earth-centred Earth-fixed metres. Exactly 16 entries. Its rigid
inverse takes ECEF points into the tile frame.

FIELD_QUANTITY.description: Physical quantity every Gaussian amplitude measures.

UNSPECIFIED.description: Not stated. A consumer MUST refuse the tile.

CLOUD_EXTINCTION.description: Visible-light extinction coefficient of cloud condensate (liquid and ice), 1/m at the Gaussian's centre.

OTHER.description: A quantity this enum cannot express; FIELD_QUANTITY_NAME names it.

FIELD_QUANTITY_NAME.description:
Producer's name for the quantity; required when FIELD_QUANTITY is
OTHER.

AMPLITUDE_UNITS.description: Units of every amplitude, UCUM or CF style (e.g. "m-1", "kg kg-1").

MASS_TOLERANCE.description:
Relative tolerance on mass conservation between any two levels of a
variant and between a tile and its children, e.g. 0.01.

INSTANCES.description: Placements of the variants in the tile frame.

COVER.description:
The producer's reduction of the source fields to this tile, present on
tiles whose GEOMETRIC_ERROR_M exceeds the cloud layer's thickness (the
sheet a consumer draws before the Gaussians resolve) and optional
elsewhere.

VALID_TIME_MS.description: Time the field is valid at, Unix milliseconds UTC.

INIT_TIME_MS.description:
Initialisation time of the run the source fields came from, Unix
milliseconds UTC. Present only for TIME_BASIS Initialization.

LEAD_HOURS.description:
Forecast lead from INIT_TIME_MS, hours. Present only for TIME_BASIS
Initialization.

TIME_BASIS.description: Which times the source publishes; governs INIT_TIME_MS and LEAD_HOURS.

Initialization.description: INIT_TIME_MS names a run; VALID_TIME_MS = INIT_TIME_MS + LEAD_HOURS * 3,600,000. This is the existing WXF convention.

ValidTimeOnly.description: Only VALID_TIME_MS is known. The source may blend runs or omit their initialization times. INIT_TIME_MS, LEAD_HOURS and HORIZON_HOURS MUST be omitted; their zero defaults do not mean a run in 1970, zero lead, or zero horizon. RETRIEVED_AT is not a substitute for initialization.

MODEL_CLASS.description: Class of the model that produced the source fields.

NumericalGlobalEnsemble.description: Physics-based numerical global ensemble forecast model.

NumericalGlobalDeterministic.description: Physics-based numerical global deterministic forecast model.

Reanalysis.description: Retrospective analysis produced by assimilating observations.

Analysis.description: Objective analysis at the initialisation time (lead 0).

Other.description: A class not covered above; MODEL_ID identifies the producer's model.

MODEL_ID.description: Producer-defined identifier of the source model.

SOURCE_FIELD_IDS.description:
FIELD_ID of every `$WXF` (or other source record) the tile was derived
from, including ones that contributed nothing, so a consumer can tell
"not consulted" from "consulted and empty".

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Peer identifier of the node that produced and published this tile.

PRODUCER_VERSION.description:
Producer software and version that authored the Gaussians, e.g.
"orbpro-gaussian-clouds 0.13.0".

PRODUCER_NOTES.description:
Producer conventions a consumer needs and this schema does not fix
(the EROSION deck convention, the erosion and warp fields' definition).

PRODUCED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds UTC when the tile was produced.

AUTHORING_SEED.description:
Seed the placement and authoring were derived from; with the source
fields it reproduces the tile.

LICENSE_CLASS.description: Licence class applicable to the derived tile at PRODUCED_AT_MS.

RealTimeExperimental.description: Real-time or future-valid data offered under an experimental real-time terms-of-use; not an official warning; redistribution limited per LICENSE_URL.

Historical.description: Data older than the producer's real-time window, offered under an open attribution licence named by LICENSE_URL.

OpenAttribution.description: Data of any valid time offered under an open attribution licence named by LICENSE_URL. Unlike Historical, this makes no claim about age or a producer's real-time window. API access terms can be more restrictive than the licence on the resulting data and must be checked separately.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the licence or terms the tile is offered under.

CITATION.description: Citation the upstream publishers ask for.
